Word Search on NoCharge: Quiet Word Hunting

The current Word Search board is an untimed eight-by-eight puzzle with four listed targets. Select endpoints that form a straight line; diagonals and reverse reading are allowed.

By NoCharge Editorial·Reviewed by NoCharge Editorial·Published August 23, 2026·Updated November 24, 2026·2 min read
Try the detail in a live board.

Find words at your own pace.

Play Word SearchBrowse all Articles

Bottom line: The current NoCharge Word Search is an untimed eight-by-eight grid. Find the four listed words—STAR, MOON, ORBIT, and COMET—by selecting a word’s first and last letters.

Valid paths

A target must read along one straight horizontal, vertical, or diagonal line. The game accepts either direction, so a word may run forward or backward. A bent path or a line that does not match an unfound target is rejected without marking a word.

The target list and found count remain visible. There is no countdown or move score; progress is the number of listed words found. Reset restores the same seeded board and clears the found list.

Controls and current page

Use the letter cells directly, or choose row and column values and activate the endpoint control twice. The current interface exposes labeled letter buttons for keyboard activation. See the live Word Search page for the exact control text and board.

This article describes the current V2 puzzle, not every Word Search layout or an older catalog’s saved-progress claims.
